parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: **[Deprecated]** The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: ClusterRuleResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID of the cluster rule.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RuleConfig
parameters.description:
The traffic redirection rule configuration.

<notice>The mode cannot be modified.</notice>
- **check_mode**: the mode. Valid values:
  - **all**: full traffic redirection.
  - **part**: partial traffic redirection.
- **type**: the rule matching type. Valid values:
  - **exact**: exact match.
  - **regex**: regular expression.
- **substance**: the rule value.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The rule status. Valid values:
- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
**[Deprecated]** The rule type. Valid values:
- **pullin**: traffic redirection configuration.
